correctness.rationale: The matching decomposition into paired horizontal cycle dimers and, at even n, precisely two opposite alternating rail matchings is bijective. Setting y_i=a_i b_i r_i r_{i+1}, the signed sum equals (product r_i)tr(product [[1,y_i],[1,0]]) plus the two possible alternating-rail signs; their product is product y_i. Lucas parity forces odd multipliers when 3∤n; for 6|n the total count and every single-edge incidence count are even, so all amplitudes vanish mod4 by character expansion. Six exact base-length sign words attain the 1/2/4 bounds, two zero seeds give 3|n cancellation, and four length-six identity transfer blocks preserve trace and product sign for every larger n, proving all-order sharpness. Distinct y and freely chosen r,a yield at least 2^(2n)4^k zero frequencies. Independently recomputed four block products and two zero seeds from actual Python-code formulas. Exhaustive short transforms in package corroborate but do not prove all n.
